newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai to open navigation services exchange.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai to open navigation services exchange.

text.p: Shanghai will open a navigation services exchange to enable customers to openly bargain for prices of international and domestic shipping services, the Shanghai Securities News said on Sunday.

The exchange, jointly set up by the Shanghai city government and the Ministry of Communications, will trade services for international and domestic cargo shipping, harbour business and ship leasing, among other things, the newspaper said.
Shanghai aimed to build itself into an international navigation centre and the establishment of the exchange was one of the steps towards the goal, it added.
